configurePresets.name: dev-gcc
configurePresets.description: Default dev build. Pins BOTH C and C++ to gcc/g++ so the toolchain can't drift into the gcc/clang mix that breaks JUCE's warning flags. The most trodden JUCE-on-Linux path. RelWithDebInfo and NOT Debug: this is the preset AGENTS.md calls the default, and at -O0 the DSP path — NAM's Eigen inference, the DspGraph interpreter, 186 AirWindows effects — runs several times slower than it ever will in production, so an engine judged 'slow' on it was being judged on the flags. Keep the symbols, lose the -O0.

configurePresets.name: dev-clang
configurePresets.description: Optional Clang build (better diagnostics). Pins BOTH C and C++ to clang. Requires the clang package. RelWithDebInfo for the same reason as dev-gcc.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: GCC with AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer for the model/diff logic. Debug on purpose, unlike the dev presets it inherits from: a sanitiser run is about the report, not the speed. For ThreadSanitizer on the audio/message-thread boundary, switch inherits to dev-clang (TSan is stronger under Clang).

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: Native Windows build for real low-latency audio (WASAPI/ASIO). Targets Visual Studio 2026 (v18, toolset v145) — needs CMake >= 4.2 (when the VS 18 2026 generator was added). For VS 2022 use generator 'Visual Studio 17 2022'. Run from a Windows shell, not WSL.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-ninja
configurePresets.description: The same compiler as windows-msvc under Ninja, for CI's compiler cache: the Visual Studio generator ignores a compiler launcher. Run from a developer environment (vcvars), which is where cl.exe and ninja come from. Debug info is embedded in each object (/Z7) rather than shared in one .pdb, which a cached object cannot write into. docs/desktop-release.md.

configurePresets.name: macos-clang
configurePresets.description: Native macOS build for real low-latency audio (CoreAudio). Unlike the dev presets this does NOT pin a compiler: on Darwin, CMake already resolves cc/c++ to Xcode's AppleClang, whereas hard-pinning bare 'clang' would grab a Homebrew LLVM if one shadows it on PATH — the opposite of the drift the pinning elsewhere prevents. Inherits base's Ninja generator rather than the Xcode one, which needs a full Xcode.app and not just the Command Line Tools. Needs: brew install cmake ninja. ASIO is Windows-only, so none of that SDK wiring applies here.

configurePresets.name: android-arm64
configurePresets.description: Cross-compiles the engine as a SHARED library for the Android app (engine/k7-android): JUCE's Oboe backend reaches Java, so on Android the engine is loaded into an app process rather than spawned. Needs ANDROID_NDK_HOME pointing at an NDK r28+ (16 KB page alignment). API 29 is the floor: JUCE's Android font code calls AFontMatcher, which is 29+. No VST3/LADSPA hosting, and no tests — they are host programs. docs/android.md.
